title: fix(ui): a related-list New runs the parent lookup's lookupAutofill; a picker's + New seeds its dependsOn parent
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AJJJRiYjshMUNgyMZSqBsr)_

Fixes #35050

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:从相关列表点「新建」打开的新建表单,预填的查找字段现在会像手动选择一样执行它声明的 `lookupAutofill`(例如从商机新建报价,客户自动带出);查找选择器里的「+ 新建」会把它按 `dependsOn` 过滤的父值预填进新记录。
- 为什么改:HotCRM 用户从商机的报价相关列表新建报价时,客户字段为空需要手填;在报价的商机选择器里新建商机也是空白,新建出来的商机甚至不在这个选择器的过滤结果里。
- 风险与回滚:只在新建表单、且查找字段带 `lookupAutofill` 时生效,只填空目标,不覆盖打开时已有的值;编辑表单不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`(开场填充的 effect 与「+ 新建」的预填);`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`(`onAutofill` 的 opening 分支改写脏基线);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx`(描述符的 `initialValues` 传给新建表单)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.dependsOn.test.tsx`,预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Half 1: an opening lookup value runs the same `lookupAutofill` as a pick.** A related list's New opens the child's create form with the relationship pre-linked (`formLink` becomes `initialValues`). The value never passed through the pick handler, so the declared targets stayed empty. Now:

- The form renderer gives a registered lookup on a create form the value it opened with (`openingValue`; `undefined` on an edit form).
- `LookupField` fills its declared targets from that record once, while the field still holds it. The record is the one hydration already reads for the chip label, so there is no second request. It uses the same `declaredLookupAutofillPatch` as a pick, with no earlier pick and without `overwrite`, so only empty targets fill. A value the form opened with is explicit and is never replaced.
- The opening record is kept as the widget's earlier pick, so a later pick replaces what the opening fill wrote, by the existing pick rule.
- The form's `onAutofill` writer takes `{ opening: true }` for this fill. It adds the filled values to the dirty baseline and writes them without `shouldDirty`. Opening New and closing at once therefore shows no "Discard changes?" prompt.
- `toHostProps` forwards `openingValue` with the other host plumbing keys. Its compile-time partition guard requires that.

**Half 2: the picker's "+ New" seeds its `dependsOn` parent.** `handleCreateNew` sends `initialValues` equal to the picker's own `dependentFilter`: the `dependsOn` values under the remote field name (`param`) the candidate query filters on. It sends them through the modal descriptor and also in the one-field inline-create fallback. The record the user creates is then one the scoped picker lists. A picker with no `dependsOn` seeds nothing.

**Location outside the claimed file surface:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx`. The lookup's create goes through `execute({ type: 'modal', modal: { objectName, mode } })`, and `useActionModal` turns that descriptor into the create form. It had no slot for opening values, so the seed would have been dropped there. `ModalDescriptor` gains `initialValues`, a descriptor-only key whose only producer is this lookup path, like `objectName`. It is read on a create only. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private. No spec key and no related-list prop is added.

## Tests

Premise, measured on `origin/main` (526282e1) before any code change. The new pins went red there: the prefill pins read `unit_price` as `''` instead of `'100'`, the modal descriptor had no `initialValues`, and the inline create sent `{ name: 'Pia Quill' }` with no parent. Both halves reproduced.

New pins:
- `plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`, new top-level describe:
  - fills the empty targets and saves them;
  - keeps every opening value, `overwrite: true` included, and fills the rest;
  - a later pick follows the pick rule;
  - the opening fill is not an edit: an untouched ModalForm closes with no discard prompt, and a touched one still asks;
  - controls: an edit form fills nothing; a lookup without the key fills nothing.
- `fields/src/widgets/LookupField.dependsOn.test.tsx`, new describe:
  - the modal create carries `initialValues` under the `param` name;
  - the inline create carries the parent;
  - control: no `dependsOn` means no `initialValues` key.
- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useActionModal.objectCreateTitle-30126.test.tsx`, new describe:
  - a create descriptor's `initialValues` open the form holding them;
  - control: without them the form opens empty.

Ablations: one per changed behaviour, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the anchor proven on disk and the blob restored to HEAD. Every mutation turned its pin red:

| Ablation | Red |
|:--|:--|
| A1: opening fill removed | 5 of 11 in the 28245 file |
| A2: modal seed removed | the seed pin |
| A3: inline-create seed removed | the inline pin |
| A4: opening baseline write removed | the discard-prompt pin |
| A5: descriptor `initialValues` not passed | the app-shell seed pin |
| A6: opening record not kept as earlier pick | the later-pick pin |

A2, A4, A5 and A6 first ran as `--replacement ''` or with a replacement already present. The tool refused them as no-ops (replacement count did not rise), so no tests ran. They were re-run with `--delete`, or with a distinct replacement for A6. Those re-runs are the readings above.

In the A5 run, the file's first test, the title pin, also failed at about 1025 ms. That is a `findByRole` timeout on a cold first test on a shared box; it passes on the unmutated tree.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound:** the opening fill runs once per opening value. If a host later resets the form's `defaultValues` to new content while the lookup keeps the same opening value, the reset clears the filled targets and they are not filled again. No path in this repo was found that resets a create form's defaults after the lookup's hydration lands.
- An opening value that is a JSON-encoded reference string is used as its own record. Its `source` keys count only if it carries them, the same rule as a pick.
- The line-item grid (`onSelectRecord` hosts) keeps applying its pairs itself. It gets no opening fill, as before.

## Verification

See the report comment on #35050 for the local subset run on the final head: commands, exit codes and the `--ran` reconciliation.
